Scene:
别的人给了神农一个灵芝。这个植物可以让神农更好。比方说，他会觉得更健康。吃灵芝以后，他可以再走。现在他觉得更好。最后，神农找到了很多植物，他可以用对药。这些植物让神农很高兴。神农想跟很多人分享他的新药。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：另外一个人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 这个植物可以让神农更好：身体更好
- 比方说，他会觉得更健康：比方说is used to express “for example”, delete it
- 吃灵芝以后，他可以再走：吃了，了completed; 又可以走了

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：一个人给了神农一个灵芝，别的人 is used to distinguish other people from a person or group already mentioned; no such contrast has been established here. [teacher rule: bieren]
Run 2: 别的人给了神农：有人给了神农，别的人 refers to people contrasted with a particular person already mentioned; here no such contrast has been established, so 有人 is appropriate. [teacher rule: bieren]
Run 3: 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：一个人给了神农一个灵芝，The expression “别的人” distinguishes other people from a person already mentioned; no such person has been established here, so introduce this new character as “一个人.” [teacher rule: bieren]

output.reason: All runs identify the unsupported use of “别的人” and replace it with an acceptable indefinite introduction of the giver.
